title: CUT TO THE CHASE
summary: A shifting pursuit — directional momentum, rest, role reversal, and sudden stop. Build a pursuit from eight excerpts. Establish a runner's direction, transfer momentum across contrasting settings, interrupt with waiting/recovery, resume by reversing pursuer and pursued, and finish on a person who stops while the world keeps moving. Cut across 8 verified public-domain archival windows (41.2s) and audited across two Critic Tribunal rounds (v1 → v2).

reviews.text:
VERDICT: repair_required (Round 1 — v1 assembly audit)
Critic Role: Independent orientation critic

Observed Defects on v1 Proof Strip:
- Seg #02 (t=03.50s-08.30s): `fc800614` cuts between highway overpass and trucks with no human runner.
- Seg #03 (t=08.30s-13.10s): `0d499ab1` is a static building facade (MotionΔ: 1.9).
- Seg #06 (t=23.10s-29.10s): `90a40e37` (`Road Runners`) shows mechanical pressure gauges instead of a person waiting.

Largest Gap:
Seg #02-#03 lack moving human figures establishing pursuit momentum, and Seg #06 shows pressure gauges instead of a person waiting/recovering.

Causal Hypothesis:
Title keyword false positive on `Road Runners` (`90a40e37`) and static cityscape match on `0d499ab1`.

Falsifiable Repair Condition:
Replace Seg #02 with human-verified crowd streaming through gates (`d2ed8576`, `0.1s-4.9s`) and Seg #03 with human-verified camera following walkers (`93053686`, `1.5s-6.3s`); replace Seg #06 with human-verified shot of a man sitting alone on rocks waiting (`398f8815`, `3.3s-7.8s`, clamped before the cut at 9.0s).

Strength to Preserve:
The lone figure sprinting across the open heath (`0143d900`), `5efa1b7b`, the head-on vector reversal (`36645c54`), deceleration (`e35796d0`), and stopping on the sidewalk while street traffic moves past (`12a45513`).
reviews.builder_note: Agreed with Round 1 critic findings. Replaced/re-windowed the flagged segments (Replace Seg #02 with human-verified crowd streaming through gates (`d2ed8576`, `0.1s-4.9s`) and Seg #03 with human-verified camera following walkers (`93053686`, `1.5s-6.3s`); replace Seg #06 with human-verified shot of a man sitting alone on rocks waiting (`398f8815`, `3.3s-7.8s`, clamped before the cut at 9.0s).) and re-rendered v2.
